notes: Seed URL (default.aspx?Refugio_County/Elections) loads over https. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Election Results page says results are posted twice on election night (early voting after 7 PM, then end of night) but does not say whether they are county totals or precinct numbers, and it links only results.texas-election.com and a turnout history PDF. Past Elections lists 2022 and earlier official cumulative, precinct and canvass PDFs; nothing for the 2024 general, 2026 primary or 2026 runoff is posted now, so checks 1 and 2 cannot decide any election. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin); the stated two-posting practice makes check 3 worthwhile here. Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-J): No change. Wayback harvest CDX was refused (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable); no targeted archives, targeted wayback or sweep file. Read the main Elections, Elections Calendar and Candidate pages: no 2024 or 2026 results files linked. Lead only: a search surfaced an unlinked county upload folder (newtools.cira.state.tx.us/upload/page/12426/...) holding '3 2026 - MAY 2 - PRECINCT RESULTS - UNOFFICIAL.pdf' ('Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results REFUGIO COUNTY, TEXAS ... Run Time 9:03 PM Run Date 05/02/2026', Last-Modified Sun, 03 May 2026 02:11:01 GMT = 9:11 PM CDT May 2), showing the county posts unofficial precinct reports on election night for local elections; the May 2 2026 local election is not a target election, and no file for the three target elections was found in that folder pattern without guessing file names (not probed). KDH News and Eastern Progress result pages returned 404.
